mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) as of the most recent month predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to compressed equity valuation multiples.
failure_condition: The rank correlation between FEDFUNDS (as of t-1mo) and 20-day returns is less than 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5% as of the most recent month, it predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to accelerated monetary tightening.
failure_condition: In more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, the 20-day returns are positive, or the rank correlation is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When both CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 315.0 and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.0% as of the most recent month, they jointly predict negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to inflation-fueled rate hikes.
failure_condition: The joint condition (CPIAUCSL > 315.0 and FEDFUNDS > 4.0) occurs, but the 20-day returns are negative more than 50% of the time, or the rank correlation is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (UNRATE < 4.0%), the S&P 500 produces positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to sustained economic expansion and corporate profit growth.
failure_condition: In more than 50% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0, the 20-day returns are negative, or the rank correlation is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A positive change in housing starts (HOUST) from the previous month (t-3mo to t-2mo) predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to leading economic activity signals.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in less than 50% of instances where HOUST increased from the previous month, or the rank correlation is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 102.0 as of the most recent month, it predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to sustained manufacturing expansion.
failure_condition: In more than 50% of instances where INDPRO > 102.0, the 60-day returns are negative, or the rank correlation is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When both housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1280 and retail sales (RSAFS) exceed 720000 as of the most recent month, they jointly predict positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to synchronized consumer demand expansion.
failure_condition: The joint condition (HOUST > 1280 and RSAFS > 720000) occurs, but the 20-day returns are negative more than 50% of the time, or the rank correlation is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) as of the most recent month predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to prolonged equity valuation compression.
failure_condition: The rank correlation between FEDFUNDS (as of t-1mo) and 60-day returns is less than 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.
